other_conditions: Must be a native of Rajasthan.
Must be enrolled in class 9 in a government school of Rajasthan.
Must belong to one of the following SBC communities: Banjara, Baldia, Labana, Gadiya‑Lohar, Gadolia, Gujar, Gurjar, Raiko, Rebari (Debasi), Gadaria (Gadri, Gyari).
benefits_summary: Free bicycles are provided to girl students studying in class 9 of government schools in Rajasthan.
